items.title: S&P Global shares rise on report of possible CapIQ spinoff
items.summary: Investing.com -- S&P Global Inc. is exploring a potential spinoff of its Capital IQ Pro data and research platform, a move that could create a standalone company valued in the high single-digit billions of dollars, Bloomberg reported on Tuesday.
